Cats vs Vampires

You hold the Leonin Pride. Across the circle, the Sanguine Court holds a hand you will only ever see the backs of.

  • Hover a card to lift it, click to hold it up and read it.
  • Drag it onto your half of the circle to play it.
  • Lands tap for mana as you spend it, and stack up along the left.
  • Attacking taps a creature unless it has vigilance.
  • Instants can also be cast while you are choosing blockers.

Prototype. Card images and rules text are Wizards of the Coast's; the board, the engine and the opponent are not.
